Offline official discovery measures existing evidence admission and coverage only; live source availability is not measured.

Case-specific fact policy is scored against independently authored strict labels; wording that asks for conditions may admit a general explanation without deciding the user’s case.
No tax conclusion is inferred from routing correctness.
